meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 该技能会在代码编辑后自动检查代码里的注释；若发现警告，会要求你修复或解释这些注释，然后才继续。
howto.when: 在你成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作之后，且注释检查器发出警告时。

say.text: 请修复这条被注释检查器标记的注释。
say.note: 会触发 Claude 根据警告修改注释。

say.text: 解释一下为什么这条注释会触发警告。
say.note: Claude 会说明检查器反馈的原因。

say.text: 先处理注释检查器的反馈再继续。
say.note: 确保警告处理后才继续后续工作。

howto.what_en: This skill automatically checks code comments after edits; if a warning is found, it asks you to fix or explain the flagged comment before proceeding.
howto.when_en: After successful apply_patch, write, edit, etc., when the comment checker emits a warning.

say_en.text: Please fix the comment flagged by the checker.
say_en.note: Claude will modify the comment based on the warning.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment triggers a warning.
say_en.note: Claude will explain the checker's feedback.

say_en.text: Handle the checker's feedback before continuing.
say_en.note: Ensures warnings are addressed before moving on.
